summary:
I replaced the two placeholders with the finished Ajustes and Acerca de screens, built only from kit components, with motion from motion/react, Untitled UI icons and no emojis.

- **Ajustes** (`/settings`, `<Page variant="tab" tabBar>` + `<TopBar large title="Ajustes">`): every control writes straight to the settings store. Groups fade in one after another on load.
  - Apariencia: Tema (Sistema / Claro / Oscuro with Monitor01 / Sun / Moon01) and Reducir animaciones.
  - Notación: Nombres de notas (Ninguno / Do Re Mi / C D E).
  - Transcripción: Sensibilidad (0-100 %), Nota mínima (40-250 ms), Cuantización (1/8, 1/16), División de manos (stepper 48-72 labelled with pitchName, with a local note-name fallback if the engine throws), Dificultad inicial. It has one footer line: "Se aplica a las próximas transcripciones."
  - Grabación: Duración máxima (30 s / 60 s / 90 s / 3 min) and Guardar audio original.
  - Reproducción: Metrónomo, Cuenta previa, Seguir partitura and Volumen.
  - Biblioteca: Exportar copia (shareOrDownload of `pauta-copia-YYYY-MM-DD.json`), Importar copia (hidden .json input, toast "N partituras importadas"), Restaurar ejemplos (calls restoreDemos), Espacio usado (storageEstimate + formatBytes, shown quietly on the right) and Borrar biblioteca (danger confirm). Action rows show a spinner while they run and ignore taps until done.
  - Then an Acerca de row (with the version and a chevron), and a quiet "Restablecer ajustes" button at the very end, which asks for confirmation first.
  - Only three settings that aren't self-explanatory get a helper line: Sensibilidad, Nota mínima and División de manos.
- **Tema switches the whole app immediately**: `<html data-theme>` changes in the same frame, and every screen, the tab bar and the browser theme-color follow. A short color fade (~0.3 s) softens the switch, and it is skipped when reduced motion is on.
  - I first tried a view transition, but Chrome sends every tap to `<html>` while one runs, so a quick second tap (Claro then Oscuro) was lost. I replaced it with a CSS fade that never blocks taps.
  - A plain color fade made the text vanish halfway, so surfaces fade while text and icons switch at the midpoint. Titles stay readable in every frame (I checked the screencast frames).
- **Acerca de** (`/about`, push screen with `<BackButton fallback="/settings" />` in a sticky bar):
  - brandIcons.logo at 80 px with a soft accent shadow, "Pauta", the version read from package.json (only the version string reaches the bundle), and one line: "Escucha una canción y obtén su partitura de piano."
  - Imágenes: every allImages entry (12), each with a thumbnail, the author and the source name. The whole row links to sourceUrl, and the license name links to licenseUrl, all in a new tab.
  - Sonidos: the CC BY 3.0 sentence word for word, with "midi-js-soundfonts" and "CC BY 3.0" linked inside it. A test checks that the visible text matches exactly.
  - Software: the 12 entries of docs/CREDITS.md (name, author and license, linked).
- **Changes from the brief**, all aimed at calmer screens:
  - Grabación máxima and Guardar audio original sit in their own small "Grabación" group, so the Transcripción card isn't seven rows long. The row is now "Duración máxima".
  - Acerca de has a "Sonidos" section for the soundfont credit.
  - Image licenses show their short form ("CC0 1.0"). The full name is in the link's aria-label.
- **Narrow phones**: at 320 px the full-width segmented controls drop their icons and use the caption size, and the split-point row text wraps instead of being cut.
- **Client feedback**: docs/CLIENT-FEEDBACK.md had no entries at the start or at the end, so there was nothing to apply.
public_api_notes:
Exports:
- `SettingsScreen` (src/features/settings/SettingsScreen.tsx) and `AboutScreen` (src/features/settings/AboutScreen.tsx): same names and paths as the placeholders, so App.tsx needs no change.
- `src/features/settings/credits.ts`: `SOFTWARE`, `SOUNDFONT_ATTRIBUTION` (the mandatory sentence, do not edit) and `SOUNDFONT_LINKS`.
- `src/features/settings/theme.ts`: `switchTheme(theme, save, animate)`.

Gotchas:
1. **Theme rule exists twice.** switchTheme sets `<html data-theme>` itself, in the same task as the store write, and adds `html.set-theme-fade` for ~340 ms. During that window the CSS in SettingsScreen.css forces color transitions on all elements (with !important) and removes the page gradient. App's useTheme is still the source of truth and sets the same value right after. If the lead changes how the theme is applied, mirror the change in `applyThemeAttribute` in theme.ts.
2. **Settings values written:**
   - `theme`, `reduceMotion`, `noteNaming`
   - `sensitivity`: 0..1, steps of 0.05; `minNoteMs`: 40..250, steps of 10
   - `quantize`: 8 | 16; `splitPoint`: 48..72; `defaultDifficulty`
   - `maxRecordSec`: 30 / 60 / 90 / 180
   - `keepOriginalAudio`, `metronome`, `countIn`, `followScore`
   - `playbackVolume`: 0..1, steps of 0.05
   - Every change is immediate (zustand persist), slider drags included.
3. **Backup file:** `pauta-copia-YYYY-MM-DD.json` (local date), sent through `shareOrDownload(blob, name, 'Copia de Pauta')`. Phones with Web Share file support get the share sheet (toast "Copia compartida"); desktop downloads (toast "Copia descargada"). An empty library shows "La biblioteca está vacía" and creates no file.
4. **restoreDemos():** Ajustes shows "N ejemplos restaurados" (or "1 ejemplo restaurado") when it returns more than 0, "Los ejemplos ya están en la biblioteca" when it returns 0, and a danger toast when it throws.
5. **Other toasts:** "N partituras importadas", "El archivo no es una copia de Pauta" (bad JSON or wrong format), "No se pudo importar la copia", "Biblioteca borrada", "Ajustes restablecidos", and "No se pudo …" for the other failures.
6. **Selectors for the integration e2e:**
   - Tema options: `[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="Tema"] [role="radio"]`, with text Sistema / Claro / Oscuro. The other radio groups use their row label as aria-label; the recording one is "Duración máxima de grabación".
   - Toggles: `button[role="switch"][aria-label="<row title>"]`. Sliders: `input[aria-label="Sensibilidad|Nota mínima|Volumen"]`.
   - Split point: `[role="spinbutton"][aria-label="División de manos"]`.
   - Library actions are `button.ui-row` rows whose `.ui-row__title` text is Exportar copia / Importar copia / Restaurar ejemplos / Borrar biblioteca / Acerca de.
   - The import input is the only `input[type="file"]` on /settings. The reset button is `.set-reset`.
   - On /about: `.set-attribution`, `.set-credit` rows (image rows contain `.set-credit__thumb`) and `.set-about__version`.
7. **Narrow screens:** the full-width segmented controls sit in `.set-below`, a CSS container. Below 300 px of container width they drop their icons.

requests.request: src/data/seed.ts: implement restoreDemos() so it re-adds missing 'demo-<slug>' items and returns how many it added. Ajustes > Restaurar ejemplos already calls it and chooses its toast from the count; with the current stub it always says "Los ejemplos ya están en la biblioteca". Keep the one-time 'pauta.demosSeeded' flag in seedDemosOnce, so Borrar biblioteca is not undone on the next reload (demos come back only through Restaurar ejemplos).

Optional kit improvements; I worked around both in settings CSS. (a) A full-width Segmented with icon + label (Sistema / Claro / Oscuro) cuts its labels at 390 px with the 14 px item padding. Settings narrows it locally (`.set-below .ui-seg__item { padding-inline: 6px }`), and in containers under 300 px drops the icons and uses 13 px text. Consider a compact padding for `full` segments in the kit. (b) ListRow title and subtitle never wrap. Settings wraps the split-point row through inner `<span class="set-wrap">` elements; a `wrap` prop would be cleaner.

src/data/db.ts importBackup() only checks id, notes, params and analysis. A hand-edited or old backup without `summary`, `title` or `coverId` would be imported and could break the library list. Consider also requiring summary and title there (or recomputing them). Low priority: files from exportBackup always include them.

known_issues: restoreDemos() is still the library agent's stub returning 0, so Restaurar ejemplos currently always shows "Los ejemplos ya están en la biblioteca".

Espacio usado reports navigator.storage.estimate() for the whole app, not just the library. In production this includes the offline cache of about 3.8 MB (model, soundfont, images), so expect roughly 4 MB plus the scores. The row is hidden where the API is missing.

The theme fade forces color-only transitions with !important on every element for about 340 ms. During that window, transitions of other properties (for example a slider thumb's press scale) don't animate. Gradients can't fade, so the page shows its flat --bg until the fade ends; the gradients differ from it by only a few levels.

Settings CSS reaches into two kit internals: `.set-below .ui-seg__item` padding and font size, and hiding `.ui-icon` inside it in narrow containers. It also wraps ListRow text through inner spans (see the ui request).
Backups exclude audio by design (db.ts), so imported items have no 'Original' playback.
With Reducir animaciones on, motion logs its dev-only notice 'You have Reduced Motion enabled…' in the dev console (already noted by the ui agent). I confirmed it is absent from the production build.

The screenshots show 3 demo items and 'Espacio usado 80 KB'. The library agent's seeding doesn't exist yet, so my screenshot and check scripts inserted the 3 demos into a throwaway headless profile only.
verification:
- **Typecheck:** `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 for the whole project, run after every change and at the end. Once mid-run it failed on src/engine/transcribe/transcribe.test.ts (owned by engine-audio, being edited in parallel); that was gone at the end.
- **Build:** `npm run build` succeeds with 134 precache entries. The bundle holds only the version from package.json (grep finds no devDependencies) plus the exact attribution string.
- **Dev behaviour checks:** a puppeteer script on my dev server at port 5188 (C:/Users/Marcos/AppData/Local/Temp/pauta/settings/check.mjs) passes 40 of 40.
  - Theme: Oscuro sets data-theme='dark' at once; the body turns rgb(15,16,21) and the meta theme-color #0f1015. Dark stays after moving to /library through the tab bar. Claro sets 'light'; Sistema removes the attribute. The choice is persisted.
  - Reducir animaciones adds html[data-reduce-motion].
  - Nombres de notas changes the split label (C4 / Do#4).
  - Keyboard changes on the sliders write 0.55, 100 ms and 0.85 to the store; stepper + gives 61; Segmented choices and all toggles persist.
  - Espacio usado shows a size.
  - Export downloads pauta-copia-2026-10-27.json, with format pauta-backup and 3 items.
  - Borrar biblioteca asks first, then empties the database and shows the toast. Exporting an empty library shows a toast and creates no file.
  - Importing that backup gives "3 partituras importadas"; a wrong file gives the danger toast. Restaurar ejemplos shows a toast.
  - Restablecer ajustes restores the defaults, theme included.
  - Acerca de: navigation and back work, and a deep link to /about goes back to /settings. It lists 12 images with 12 license links and 12 software rows; the attribution text matches exactly; every link has target=_blank with rel noopener; the version reads 'Versión 0.1.0'; the logo loads at 80 px.
  - No console errors or warnings, apart from motion's dev-only reduced-motion notice.
- **Production check:** the same flows on `node scripts/serve.mjs start 5188 --preview` pass 10 of 10, with zero console errors or warnings, and all 12 thumbnails and the logo load.
- **Visual review:** I looked at every shot with the Read tool, in light and dark (390x844 @2x).
  - Full-page shots were taken by resizing the viewport to the content height, so the fixed tab bar and page gradient sit where they would on a tall phone. Puppeteer's own fullPage capture left the tab bar floating mid-page.
  - Also checked: 320 px layouts, the About bar after scrolling, and screencast frames of the theme fade.
- **Cleanup:** I stopped the server with `node scripts/serve.mjs stop 5188`; status reports nothing listening on 5188.
